tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: Search the directory of allergists offering ILIT. Give a zip code, a city, "City, ST", a state name or code, or coordinates. Results come nearest first with the distance in miles; a 50-mile radius splits "within" from "further", but people travel far for ILIT, so always show the closest ones even wh

tools.name: get_practitioner
tools.description: One listing in full: practitioner and certification, address, phone, website, hours, allergens, availability, protocol, cost, other offices of the same clinic, and which requests the listing accepts. Identify it by id, slug, URL, or the clinic or practitioner name.

tools.name: list_practices
tools.description: Every clinic in the directory with its practitioner and offices (id, city, state, phone, URL). Optional state filter.

tools.name: list_allergens
tools.description: List the allergens the directory tracks (name, slug, page URL) with how many listed offices treat each with ILIT. Use it to pick a valid allergen for find_practitioners or apply_for_listing, or to answer which allergens practices here treat. Takes no input.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Overview of the site in one call: what ILIT Society is, live counts (offices, practitioners, states, allergens, articles), how finding a practitioner and sending requests work, its limits, the contact address and links to its machine-readable docs. Use it for context about the site itself; for a que

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a question about ILIT (intralymphatic immunotherapy) from the Society’s published questions and answers: what ILIT is, the treatment, evidence and approval, cost and insurance, finding a practitioner, consultations and appointments, the Society, listing criteria. Give a question or keywords;

tools.name: search_journal
tools.description: Search the Society’s Journal, longer articles for patients and practitioners, by keywords and/or topic. Returns matching articles with title, date, summary, key points and URL; read one in full with get_article. For a short factual answer use answer_question instead.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get the full text of one Journal article with its title, URL and reviewer. Identify it by the slug, id or URL that search_journal returned, or by title (best match). Use after search_journal when the summary is not enough.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Send a consultation request (a first conversation, at the practice or over Zoom) to a listing that offers consultations. The practice contacts the person within two business days to confirm a time; nothing is booked by the site. Requires the person’s name, phone, email and consent=true.

tools.name: request_appointment
tools.description: For a person who has decided to start ILIT: send an appointment request to a listing that accepts them. The practice contacts the person within two business days to confirm dates; nothing is booked by the site. Requires name, phone, email and consent=true.

tools.name: apply_for_listing
tools.description: For an allergist or immunologist offering ILIT: submit a listing application. The Society checks board certification against the ABAI register and creates the listing by hand; nothing is published automatically. Requires confirm_accurate=true and confirm_terms=true.

tools.name: how_to_get_in_touch
tools.description: Contact routes only: the Society’s email address, how a practice applies for a listing and the listing criteria, and how a person reaches a practice (a consultation or appointment request through the site, or the listing’s own phone and website). Takes no input.

tools.name: what_the_site_does_not_do
tools.description: The site’s limits, to state before acting for a person: it takes no bookings, gives no medical advice, holds no medical records, does not rank practitioners and sets no prices of its own; and ILIT is not FDA-approved, so in the US it is given off-label. Takes no input.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_practitioner, list_practices, list_allergens, search_journal, get_article, how_to_get_in_touch · Private data: get_facts, request_consultation, request_appointment, how_to_get_in_touch, what_the_site_does_not_do · Public sink: request_consultation, request_appointment, apply_for_listing, how_to_get_in_touch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_practitioner, list_practices, list_allergens, search_journal, get_article, how_to_get_in_touch · Private data: get_facts, request_consultation, request_appointment, how_to_get_in_touch, what_the_site_does_not_do · Public sink: request_consultation, request_appointment, apply_for_listing, how_to_get_in_touch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
